rules.title: The FAFSA is open
rules.body: Filing early improves aid odds. The federal window closes June 30.

rules.title: Kindergarten registration season
rules.body: Most districts open kindergarten registration in late winter for a fall start, and dates are set locally — check your district's calendar this month.

rules.title: PSAT season for juniors
rules.body: The PSAT is given each October — the National Merit qualifier and a dry run for the SAT. Registration runs through the school, usually by early fall.
